enabled.description: Enabled turns speech transcription on. Also send asr_model_id.

language.description: Language is an optional hint for transcription, such as zh or en.

model_id.description: Model that transcribes audio. model.list returns the ids.

enabled.description: Enabled turns automatic tagging on. The model picks from tags that already exist.

max_tags.description: MaxTags is how many tags one document may receive, from 1 to 10.

model_id.description: ModelID overrides the summary model. Empty uses summary_model_id.

skip_if_tagged.description: SkipIfTagged leaves a document alone when it already has tags. Empty means yes.

chunk_index.description: Index position of the chunk in the original document

chunk_type.description: Chunk 类型，用于区分不同类型的 Chunk

content.description: Actual text content of the chunk

content_hash.description: ContentHash 存储内容的 hash 值，用于快速匹配（主要用于 FAQ）

content_revision.description: ContentRevision is incremented for every user edit or rollback.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker, supports data recovery

end_at.description: Ending character position in the original text

flags.description:
Flags 存储多个布尔状态的位标志（如推荐状态等）
默认值为 ChunkFlagRecommended (1)，表示默认可推荐

id.description: Unique identifier of the chunk, using UUID format

index_status.description:
IndexStatus reports whether the current content is reflected in the
retrieval stores: ready | processing | failed.

indirect_relation_chunks.description: 间接关系 Chunk ID，用于关联间接关系 Chunk 和原始文本 Chunk

is_enabled.description: Whether the chunk is enabled, can be used to temporarily disable certain chunks

knowledge_base_id.description: ID of the knowledge base, for quick location

knowledge_id.description: ID of the parent knowledge, associated with the Knowledge model

last_editor_id.description: LastEditorID records the actor that produced the current revision.

metadata.description: Metadata 存储 chunk 级别的扩展信息，例如 FAQ 元数据

parent_chunk_id.description: 父 Chunk ID，用于关联图片 Chunk 和原始文本 Chunk

relation_chunks.description: 关系 Chunk ID，用于关联关系 Chunk 和原始文本 Chunk

seq_id.description: SeqID is an auto-increment integer ID for external API usage (FAQ entries)

source_locators.description:
SourceLocators point back into the original file (page and region,
slide, sheet rows, ...) so citations can open the file at this chunk.
Empty when the parser reported no positions.

start_at.description: Starting character position in the original text

tag_id.description: Optional tag ID for categorization within a knowledge base (used for FAQ)

tenant_id.description: Tenant ID, used for multi-tenant isolation

child_chunk_size.description:
ChildChunkSize is the size of child chunks used for embedding (default: 384).
Only used when EnableParentChild is true.

chunk_size.description: Chunk size in characters. Empty on create uses the server default.

enable_parent_child.description:
EnableParentChild splits into large parent chunks and small child chunks.
Search matches a child and returns its parent.

languages.description: Languages hints the splitter, for example de or zh. Empty detects the language from the document.

parent_chunk_size.description:
ParentChunkSize is the size of parent chunks (default: 4096).
Only used when EnableParentChild is true.

parser_engine_rules.description:
ParserEngineRules configures which parser engine to use for each file type.
When empty, the builtin engine is used for all types.

separators.description: Separators, in the order they are tried.

strategy.description:
Strategy selects how documents are split: auto, heading, heuristic,
recursive or legacy. Empty keeps the server default.

table_metadata_instructions.description: TableMetadataInstructions is extra guidance for CSV and Excel summaries. The output format stays fixed.

token_limit.description: TokenLimit caps chunk size in approximate tokens. 0 uses ChunkSize as a character count.

title.description: Title of the document; defaults to the fetched one.

url.description: Page or file URL to import.

agent_enabled.description: Whether agent mode is enabled for this request

agent_id.description: Selected custom agent ID (backend resolves shared agent and its workspace from share relation)

agent_source_tenant_id.description: Optional disambiguator; backend still verifies the share relation

assistant_access.description:
AssistantAccess is the Product assistant access level: read_only,
confirm or auto_write. The workspace ceiling caps it; other agents
ignore it.

disable_title.description: Whether to disable auto title generation

knowledge_base_ids.description: Selected knowledge base ID for this request

knowledge_ids.description: Selected knowledge ID for this request

page_context.description: PageContext is the Product page the user has open (agent mode only).

query.description: Query text for knowledge base search

question_origin.description: QuestionOrigin is the knowledge source of a picked suggested question.

reasoning_effort.description: ReasoningEffort overrides thinking for this request; empty inherits the agent configuration.

summary_model_id.description: Optional summary model ID for this request (overrides session default)

web_search_enabled.description: Whether web search is enabled for this request

valid.description: Valid is true if Time is not NULL

custom_instructions.description: CustomInstructions adds domain guidance. The graph output format stays fixed.

enabled.description: Enabled turns graph extraction on. Node and relation types are edited in the knowledge base editor.

tags.description: Tags are the entity labels extraction may use.

text.description: Text is the extraction prompt. Required when extraction is on and no text is saved yet.

url.description: serving URL after saving to storage

on.description:
On is the list of attribute conditions that enable OCR. Matching any one
turns OCR on.

on_unobserved.description:
OnUnobserved is the OCR decision used when the observation does not
answer for one of the attributes the policy reads — the attribute is
absent because the model skipped the line, or because the value it wrote
was not one of the allowed ones. The default is true: an incomplete
observation keeps extracting, so a missed block of text costs one extra
call instead of being lost. Turn it off only with a model reliable enough
to answer every attribute line.

image_actions.description:
ImageActions overrides the built-in attribute→work table (see
DefaultImageActions). A nil value keeps the conservative default: run OCR
for block text, data visuals, and unobserved images.

image_attrs_enabled.description:
ImageAttrsEnabled turns the attribute-observed image pipeline on for this
knowledge base. It is off by default on purpose, so upgrading an
existing deployment never changes what happens to documents already
being ingested: with it off every image is described and OCR'd exactly
as before. When on, the describe round also observes image attributes and
the attribute policy decides whether OCR runs for it. A single upload can
override it per document through
KnowledgeProcessOverrides.ImageAttrsEnabled.

image_pipeline.description:
ImagePipelineID selects the image pipeline by id, so the choice the
settings panel offers is the choice the backend runs. It is unset on
knowledge bases configured before the field existed; those follow
ImageAttrsEnabled — see ResolveImagePipelineID. An explicit id always
wins over the switch.

image_pipeline_params.description:
ImagePipelineParams holds the tunables of ImagePipelineID, keyed by the
field's own key. The map travels whole: a key a pipeline no longer
declares is dropped when the run reads it, so an old stored config stays
loadable rather than being rewritten on save.

image_vector_enabled.description:
ImageVectorEnabled lets a knowledge base whose embedding model takes
images index each image by its own vector and recall it with one. It
is off by default on purpose: a model that takes images is also used
for plain text, and turning this on costs an embedding call per image
and widens vector recall. Existing knowledge bases stay off after an
upgrade because the stored JSON has no such key.

model_id.description: Model ID used when describing images. Empty uses the knowledge base's caption model.

graph_enabled.description: GraphEnabled enables knowledge graph entity/relation extraction

vector_enabled.description: VectorEnabled enables semantic vector embedding and search

wiki_enabled.description: WikiEnabled enables automatic wiki page generation from documents

faq.description: FAQ means the KB is a FAQ-type KB (Q/A pairs).

graph.description: Graph means knowledge-graph extraction is enabled.

keyword.description: Keyword means BM25 / sparse keyword search is indexed.

vector.description: Vector means semantic (embedding) search is indexed.

wiki.description: Wiki means the wiki feature is enabled and authored pages exist / will be generated.

channel.description: Channel indicates through which channel the knowledge was ingested (web, api, browser_extension, wechat, etc.)

custom_metadata.description:
CustomMetadata is user-authored descriptive metadata. It is deliberately
separate from Metadata, which contains internal ingestion state and IDs.

folder_path.description:
FolderPath is the canonical relative directory this entry belongs to
inside the knowledge base, e.g. "docs/spec" for a folder upload of
"docs/spec/design.md". Empty means the knowledge base root. It is a
display/navigation concern only: it never affects where the file is
physically stored (see FilePath).

knowledge_base_name.description: Knowledge base name (not stored in database, populated on query)

last_activity_at.description:
Most recent processing progress (row or span write) for an in-flight
row, so clients can tell a slow stage from a stalled one. Not stored.

last_faq_import_result.description: Last FAQ import result (for FAQ type knowledge only)

pending_subtasks_count.description:
PendingSubtasksCount is the outstanding enrichment subtask count
(summary + question + graph chunks). Only meaningful while
ParseStatus == "finalizing"; defaults to 0 in any terminal state.

profile.description:
Profile is the structured companion of Description: a one-line gist,
topic keywords, a document type and one typical question. It is produced
by the same model call as the summary and feeds the knowledge-base
level description aggregation. nil when no summary has been generated.

source.description: Source of the knowledge (e.g. URL address for url type, "manual" for manual type)

stall_state.description:
Verdict on an in-flight row gone quiet: StallStateQueued (its work is
still queued, i.e. backlogged) or StallStateStalled (nothing left to
run it). Empty while it is progressing or the probe failed. Not stored.

summary_status.description: Summary status for async summary generation

tags.description: Tags holds the tags associated with this knowledge (populated on query, not persisted directly).

updated_at.description: Last updated time of the knowledge

aggregate_hash.description:
AggregateHash identifies the aggregate the gist was generated from. A
mismatch with the live aggregate means the text is stale.

error.description: Error holds the last generation error when Status is failed.

generated_at.description: GeneratedAt records when the text was produced.

gist.description: Gist is a short statement of what the knowledge base covers.

model_id.description: ModelID records which chat model produced the text.

stats.description: Stats is the aggregate snapshot the text was generated from.

status.description: Status is one of the KnowledgeBaseProfileStatus* values.

topics.description: Topics is the merged topic list (at most KnowledgeBaseProfileMaxTopics).

typical_questions.description: TypicalQuestions lists questions this knowledge base can answer.

custom_instructions.description:
CustomInstructions is appended to the stable system prompt, e.g. the
audience the description should address or terms to keep.

enabled.description: Enabled turns the AI knowledge-base description on.

model_id.description: ModelID overrides the chat model; empty falls back to the KB summary model.

doc_types.description: DocTypes counts documents per model-assigned document type.

document_count.description: DocumentCount is the number of eligible documents at generation time.

earliest_at.description: EarliestAt and LatestAt bound document creation times.

file_types.description: FileTypes counts documents per file extension.

folders.description: Folders lists the top-level folder names present.

profiled_count.description: ProfiledCount is how many of them carried a document profile.

raw_topics.description: RawTopics counts documents per normalized topic keyword before merging.

tags.description: Tags counts documents per knowledge-base tag.

auto_tag_config.description: AutoTagConfig controls asynchronous association of existing tags after parsing.

chunk_count.description: Chunk count (not stored in database, calculated on query)

created_at.description: Creation time of the knowledge base

creator_id.description:
CreatorID records the user ID of whoever originally created the KB.
Used by the workspace-level RBAC middleware to let Contributors edit
their own KBs without granting them access to everyone else's.
Nullable for backward compatibility with rows created before the
RBAC migration backfilled the column to the workspace Owner.

creator_name.description:
CreatorName 是 CreatorID 对应用户的展示名（username / email 等），
仅在列表场景由 handler 批量回填，不落库；为空表示创建者无法解析（用户已删除、
CreatorID 为空的老数据等）。前端用它在卡片来源徽章上做 mine vs workspace 的二分。

deleted_at.description: Deletion time of the knowledge base

embedding_model_id.description: ID of the immutable embedding model. Use the copy/migration workflow to change it.

faq_config.description: FAQConfig stores FAQ specific configuration such as indexing strategy

generated_profile.description:
GeneratedProfile is the machine-generated description: a gist, merged
topics, typical questions and the aggregate snapshot they came from. It
never overwrites the user-authored Description; both are shown to agents.

id.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base

indexing_strategy.description:
IndexingStrategy controls which indexing pipelines are active for this knowledge base.
Pipelines: vector search, keyword search, wiki generation, knowledge graph extraction.

is_pinned.description:
IsPinned and PinnedAt are computed per-caller from user_kb_pins
(see migration 000050). They used to be stored on the row itself,
which made pinning a workspace-wide ordering decision gated behind
the kb-edit RBAC guard. The columns are still present in legacy
schemas for rollback safety but are no longer read or written by
the application — both fields are tagged `gorm:"-"` so GORM
ignores them on every CRUD call and the list handler stamps them
after enriching with the caller's pin set.

is_processing.description: IsProcessing indicates if there is a processing import task (for FAQ type knowledge bases)

is_temporary.description: Whether this knowledge base is temporary (ephemeral) and should be hidden from UI

knowledge_count.description: Knowledge count (not stored in database, calculated on query)

my_permission.description:
MyPermission is the caller's role on a knowledge base shared from
another workspace; GET /knowledge-bases/{id} sets it.

pinned_at.description:
PinnedAt records when the current caller pinned this knowledge
base; nil when they have not.

processing_count.description: ProcessingCount indicates the number of knowledge items being processed (for document type knowledge bases)

profile_config.description:
ProfileConfig controls automatic generation of the knowledge-base
description from per-document profiles (document knowledge bases only).

question_generation_config.description: QuestionGenerationConfig stores question generation configuration for document knowledge bases

share_count.description: ShareCount indicates the number of organizations this knowledge base is shared with (not stored in database)

storage_backend_id.description:
StorageBackendID binds this KB to one concrete storage instance. The
legacy provider field remains readable during migration only.

storage_provider_config.description: Storage provider config (new): only stores provider selection; credentials from workspace StorageEngineConfig

summary_model_id.description:
Summary model ID. model.list returns the ids. Used for summaries, and as
the default for auto-tagging and the AI description.

type.description: Type of the knowledge base: document, faq or wiki. Empty means document.

updated_at.description: Last updated time of the knowledge base

vector_store_id.description:
VectorStoreID references the VectorStore this knowledge base is bound to.
When nil, the KB falls back to the workspace's effective engines derived from
the RETRIEVE_DRIVER environment variable (env store flow).
This field is set once at creation time and must not be modified afterwards;
enforcement lives at the GORM layer (`<-:create`) plus the service-layer
KB update path, which omits this field from its update DTO.

wiki_config.description: WikiConfig stores wiki-specific configuration (only for wiki type knowledge bases)

image_actions.description:
ImageActions overrides rows of the attribute->work table for this document
(merged per action key on top of the knowledge base's table).
nil keeps the knowledge base's setting.

image_attrs_enabled.description:
ImageAttrsEnabled overrides the knowledge base's attribute-observed image
pipeline switch for this one document. nil keeps the knowledge base's
setting.

image_pipeline.description:
ImagePipelineID overrides which image pipeline runs for this one
document. nil keeps the knowledge base's resolved pipeline. When set,
ImagePipelineParams travels with it: the params of one pipeline are
meaningless to another, so the pair is replaced as a unit.

image_pipeline_params.description:
ImagePipelineParams are the overridden pipeline's private tunables. They
are only applied together with ImagePipelineID.

image_vector_enabled.description:
ImageVectorEnabled overrides image vector indexing for this document.
It does not change the KB-wide retrieval setting or embedding model.

parser_engine_overrides.description:
ParserEngineOverrides passes key-value configuration to docreader parsers
(e.g. pdf_force_scanned=true). Merged with workspace-level overrides in the
parse pipeline; per-upload values take priority on conflict.

summary_enabled.description: SummaryEnabled defaults to true when omitted for backward compatibility.

doc_type.description: DocType is a coarse label such as "user manual", "meeting notes" or "contract".

gist.description: Gist is a one-line statement of what the document is about.

typical_question.description: TypicalQuestion is one natural-language question this document answers.

attempt.description: Attempt is the attempt the trace describes; equals CurrentAttempt.

current_stage.description: CurrentStage is the stage running now, or the last one that ran.

last_activity_at.description: LastActivityAt is set while the parse is in flight.

stall_state.description:
StallState is types.StallStateQueued or types.StallStateStalled when an
in-flight parse has gone quiet.

knowledge_base_id.description: Knowledge base ID that this tag belongs to

name.description: Tag name, unique within the same knowledge base

seq_id.description: SeqID is an auto-increment integer ID for external API usage

sort_order.description: Sort order within the same knowledge base

content.description:
Markdown content. The assistant may send a full document; the API limit
is 200000 runes, and x-agent-max-bytes covers that in UTF-8.

status.description: draft keeps the document out of search; publish indexes it.

x-enum-comments.MatchTypeDirectLoad: Deprecated: reserved to preserve serialized enum values

x-enum-descriptions: Deprecated: reserved to preserve serialized enum values

kb_id.description: Parent knowledge base for file/tag mentions

service_id.description: Parent MCP service for MCP tool mentions

kb_id.description: Parent knowledge base for file/tag mentions

service_id.description: Parent MCP service for MCP tool mentions

section.description: part of the page in view, e.g. an editor tab

selection.description: Selection is the text the user selected on the page. Assistant only.

title.description:
Title is the page's name as the client's navigation shows it, e.g.
"Agents"; it names pages without an identifier. Assistant only.

view.description:
View is the title of the dialog or drawer open over the page, as the
page shows it. Assistant only.

xlsx_first_row_as_header.description:
XLSXFirstRowAsHeader restores row-1 column context for flat XLSX tables.
nil preserves the parser default; an explicit false disables the mode.

custom_instructions.description: CustomInstructions describes who the questions are for. The question format stays fixed.

enabled.description: Enabled turns question generation on. Generated questions are indexed beside the chunk.

question_count.description: QuestionCount is how many questions to write per chunk, from 1 to 10.

process_config.description: ProcessConfig overrides the processing options stored at upload time.

applied.description: Applied is true when rerank scores decided the returned order.

error.description: Error carries the reason for model_error / model_unavailable.

images_scored.description: ImagesScored counts image-based rerank calls; ImagesKept records pictorial fallbacks.

model_id.description: ModelID and ModelSource (request / tenant / auto) identify the model.

threshold.description:
Threshold is the requested minimum score; EffectiveThreshold is the one
applied after degradation.

top_score.description: TopScore is the best rerank model score among the candidates.

enabled.description: Enabled turns the rerank stage off when explicitly false. Nil means on.

model_id.description:
ModelID selects the rerank model. Empty falls back to the tenant
RetrievalConfig, then to the first rerank model of the tenant.

threshold.description:
Threshold is the minimum rerank model score. Nil uses the tenant
RetrievalConfig. A pointer because 0 and negative scores are valid.

top_k.description: TopK caps the reranked results. Zero uses the endpoint's result count.

knowledge_base_id.description: Single knowledge base ID (for backward compatibility)

knowledge_base_ids.description: IDs of knowledge bases to search (multi-KB support)

knowledge_ids.description: IDs of specific knowledge (files) to search

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs for filtering within a single KB

vector_threshold.description: Optional overrides of the tenant retrieval config. Omitted fields keep it.

chunk_metadata.description: ChunkMetadata stores chunk-level metadata (e.g., generated questions)

knowledge_base_id.description: KnowledgeBaseID is the ID of the knowledge base this result belongs to

knowledge_channel.description: KnowledgeChannel indicates through which channel the knowledge was ingested (web, api, wechat, etc.)

knowledge_custom_metadata.description: KnowledgeCustomMetadata is user-authored context safe to expose to models.

knowledge_description.description: KnowledgeDescription is the description of the knowledge document

knowledge_filename.description:
Knowledge file name
Used for file type knowledge, contains the original file name

knowledge_source.description:
Knowledge source
Used to indicate the source of the knowledge, such as "url"

matched_content.description:
MatchedContent is the actual content that was matched in vector search
For FAQ: this is the matched question text (standard or similar question)

matched_images.description:
MatchedImages survives merging, deduplication and stored reference replay.
It contains storage references, never image bytes.

source_locators.description:
SourceLocators point back into the original file for citation
navigation. Merged results carry the union of their chunks' locators.

forked_from_message_id.description:
ForkedFromMessageID is the user or assistant message, IN THE PARENT
SESSION, that the fork branched at. For a user point, messages strictly
before it were copied here. For an assistant point, that answer is
included so the branch continues after it.

im_platform.description:
IMPlatform is the originating IM platform (e.g. "feishu", "wecom") when
this session is bound to an IM channel. It is not stored on the sessions
table (it lives in im_channel_sessions) and is populated on read so the
Web console can classify a session's origin folder without a list query.

is_pinned.description: IsPinned indicates whether the session is pinned in the list.

kind.description:
Kind is empty for ordinary chats and SessionKindAssistant for assistant
conversations; it is set at creation and never updated.

last_request_state.description:
LastRequestState records the input-bar state used the last time this
session sent a question (agent, model, KB scope, web search, MCPs).
Persisted on every successful POST to /knowledge-chat or /agent-chat so
that reopening the session can restore the original request context to
the chat UI. Stored in the legacy sessions.agent_config JSONB column to
avoid a new migration; the shape used today is `SessionLastRequestState`.

parent_session_id.description:
ParentSessionID names the session this one was forked from. Empty for
ordinary sessions. Deliberately not a foreign key: the parent may be
deleted while the branch lives on, and a branch must not cascade away
with it. A dangling value simply renders as an ordinary session.

pinned_at.description: PinnedAt records when the session was pinned; nil when not pinned.

sandbox_config_id.description:
SandboxConfigID pins which sandbox config this session's CURRENT live
sandbox was created on. Empty means no live sandbox;
SandboxConfigIDGlobalDefault means the deployment-wide default config.

This is an ephemeral pin that dies with the sandbox, not a permanent
owner: sessions outlive sandboxes by months, so treating it as
permanent would make "no session references this config" never true.

user_id.description:
UserID is the owner scope for this session. Product user UUIDs, API
external-user principals, and embed visitor principals all use this column.

bbox.description:
BBox is [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the page width and height,
origin at the top-left corner of the rendered page.

block.description: Block is the 1-based index among a Word file's body paragraphs and tables.

mapping.description: Mapping records verified text-to-source alignment. Empty means legacy.

partial.description: Partial means some of the chunk has no source mapping.

quote.description:
Quote is the complete cited overlap as parsed. Viewers match it
inside the rendered original and against the
answer sentence that cites the chunk.

section.description: Section is the 1-based EPUB spine index.

sheet.description:
Sheet is the spreadsheet sheet name; RowStart/RowEnd are its 1-based
row numbers as shown by spreadsheet applications.

slide.description: Slide is the 1-based slide number in presentation order.

source_hash.description: SourceHash binds the locator to the knowledge record’s source revision hash.

source_id.description: SourceID identifies a block within the parser result, not a rendered item.

start.description: Start/End are rune offsets into the original text file.

title.description: Title names the section or slide when the source has one.

cached_tokens.description:
CachedTokens is the legacy alias for CacheReadTokens. It remains on the
wire for compatibility with existing API consumers.

context_token_scale.description: ContextTokenScale restores the previous turn's text-token calibration.

custom_instructions.description: CustomInstructions adds image-reading guidance. The OCR and Markdown format stay fixed.

description_language.description: DescriptionLanguage is the language of generated image captions. Empty follows the document language.

enabled.description: Enabled turns image captions on. Also send vlm_model_id.

model_id.description: Model that writes image captions. model.list returns the ids.

content_instructions.description: ContentInstructions sets tone and emphasis for generated Wiki prose. Citations stay fixed.

extraction_granularity.description: ExtractionGranularity is focused, standard or exhaustive. Empty means standard.

extraction_instructions.description: ExtractionInstructions tells page extraction which concepts to keep. The output format stays fixed.

ingest_batch_size.description:
IngestBatchSize controls how many pending ops a single batch claims and
processes before scheduling a follow-up. 0 falls back to the hard-coded
default (5). Larger batches amortize per-batch setup and let more docs
share the batch-internal Map/Reduce fan-out; smaller batches spread a
KB's backlog across more concurrent batches (finer scheduling grain).

ingest_map_parallel.description:
IngestMapParallel sets the errgroup limit for the Map phase
(per-document extraction + summary + chunk citation) WITHIN one batch.
0 falls back to 10. Bound by the LLM provider's concurrency limit and
the worker's outbound HTTP pool. Remember it multiplies with the number
of concurrent batches (IngestMaxInflight).

ingest_max_inflight.description:
IngestMaxInflight caps how many ingest batches for THIS KB may run
concurrently in the shared wiki worker pool (standard/Redis mode
only). 0 falls back to the hard-coded default (4). Since Phase 3
removed the exclusive per-KB lock, one KB's backlog could otherwise
monopolize the whole pool during a bulk import and starve other KBs;
this knob trades a single KB's peak throughput for cross-KB fairness.
Set it >= the wiki pool size to effectively disable the cap.

ingest_reduce_parallel.description:
IngestReduceParallel sets the errgroup limit for the Reduce phase
(per-slug page write) WITHIN one batch. 0 falls back to 10. Bound by the
same LLM concurrency / HTTP pool considerations as the Map phase, plus
DB connection pool size. Same multiplier caveat as IngestMapParallel.

max_pages_per_ingest.description: MaxPagesPerIngest limits pages created or updated per ingest. 0 means no limit.

synthesis_model_id.description: SynthesisModelID is the model that writes Wiki pages. Empty uses summary_model_id.

429/backoff and transient transport failures do not trigger account fallback.
